item.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor on Trump's embrace of Russia
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff visits Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff visits Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

item.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
item.description: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

item.title: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, source tells NPR
item.description: The U.S. and Israel are preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran in early November, after the U.S. midterm elections, a person briefed on war planning told NPR. Iran said it is prepared.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Bukele says military operation launched to rescue Salvadorans held by gangs in Haiti
item.description: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele said Wednesday he had launched a military operation to rescue four Salvadoran aviation technicians kidnapped by gangs in Haiti.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: North Korea says it will resume propaganda broadcasts across border into South Korea
item.description: North Korea plans to resume anti-Seoul propaganda broadcasts along the heavily armed border with South Korea, leader Kim Jong Un's sister said, reviving a psychological warfare campaign.

item.title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
item.description: The pro-Israel lobbying group and influential political funder announced it would no longer endorse candidates or give directly to campaigns. AIPAC's affiliated super PAC, though, will continue.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Putin releases American Stephen Hubbard from Russian prison
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has freed another American, 74-year-old Michigan native Stephen Hubbard, from a Russian prison following a request from President Trump.

item.title: Meet the people moving north to escape increasingly hot summers
item.description: As climate change fuels hotter summers, some Britons are moving north in search of cooler weather. Could a similar shift be on the horizon in the United States?

item.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
